problemStatement: How does a capture-first notebook surface make entry instant and reading calm, versus the organization-first chrome of conventional note managers?
whyThisProblem: NodeKit generates note and stream surfaces (Mew migration, NodeMem views). The owner's direction names Ideaflow/Mew as the target convention. The mechanism must be extracted as facts before any template inherits it, or the template inherits vibes.
licenceNote: Mew observations attribute to the owner-authorized local source checkout via file: URI (live inspection of owner-owned code, not a third-party licence question). Mobbin entries store our observations and the mobbin_url only, never pixels.
capturedVia: source-code read of personal-dev-mew (read-only), owner-supplied desktop+iOS screenshots, Mobbin MCP search_screens

facts.subject: chrome grays
facts.value: grays are teal-tinted: #7f8b8b light / #667373 dark, not neutral gray

facts.subject: type scale
facts.locatorDescription: global.css:165-171 — 11/12/13/14/16/18/32px named micro..xl; one display size only

facts.subject: elevation
facts.value: 3 shadow tokens, all <=8px blur, low alpha (0.05-0.067)

observations.observedTension: A 12-step accent ramp exists but the visible product uses the accent almost exclusively for hashtags and indicators — the ramp serves states, not decoration.
observations.boundary: Source tokens prove the vocabulary, not its runtime usage frequency; no computed-style audit was run.

observations.surface: ThoughtStream (owner-supplied desktop + iOS screenshots, cross-checked against source)

facts.subject: note separation
facts.value: horizontal divider only — no cards, no borders, no per-note background
facts.locatorDescription: desktop screenshot: stream region; notes end with a 1px rule

facts.subject: chromatic emphasis
facts.value: inline hashtags and links are the only colored elements in body text; all other chrome achromatic
facts.locatorDescription: both screenshots: teal #hashtags and links against near-black

facts.subject: left rail
facts.locatorDescription: desktop: All Notes/To-dos/Public/Calendar, Pinned, Folders, Hashtags, Help/Settings; per-tag counts right-aligned

facts.subject: capture affordance
facts.value: cmd+k/ctrl+k adds to top of stream; iOS shows persistent FAB pair (mic + compose) bottom-right
facts.locatorDescription: onboarding note text; iOS screenshot bottom-right

facts.subject: onboarding
facts.value: onboarding content is ordinary notes inside the stream, not a modal tour
facts.locatorDescription: both screenshots: welcome/tips are stream entries with dividers

facts.subject: mobile parity
facts.value: identical single stream; rail collapses; no bottom tab bar

observations.observedTension: Search sits top-center as a pill on both platforms — the one persistent chrome element besides the rail.
observations.boundary: Screenshots show the signed-out sample notebook (8 notes); density at 1,000+ notes not observed. iOS corroboration exists but this record is filed under web (schema allows one platform); mobile facts cite the iOS screenshot in their locators.

facts.subject: workspace
facts.locatorDescription: Mobbin screen: sidebar + note list + editor

facts.subject: note representation
facts.value: each note is a bordered card in a dedicated list pane; editing opens a third pane

facts.subject: left rail
facts.locatorDescription: Mobbin screen: Home through Spaces plus shortcuts

facts.subject: capture
facts.value: capture requires choosing a destination type first (Note/Task/Event buttons)
facts.locatorDescription: Mobbin screen: three green CTAs top-left

observations.observedTension: The organization chrome that aids retrieval at scale is the same chrome that adds steps before a first keystroke of capture.
observations.boundary: Static screens; task-completion timing not observed (M2 ceiling).

observations.surface: note opened as centered modal document with AI side panel

facts.subject: note representation
facts.value: note opens as a floating document card over a dimmed workspace, with heading hierarchy
facts.locatorDescription: Mobbin screen: centered white card, H1 + bold section heads

facts.subject: AI assistant
facts.value: persistent right-hand panel with its own chat input, separate from the note body
facts.locatorDescription: Mobbin screen: right column with model picker

observations.observedTension: Document-modal reading rewards long-form structure; it is the opposite trade from stream capture speed.

notRun: Roam Research comparator: Mobbin holds no Roam screens — query 'Roam Research daily notes page with bullet outline and backlinks' returned Fabric and Evernote instead; recorded as coverage boundary, not substituted.
Motion: no runtime observation of Mew transitions was made; motion facts are absent, not fine.
Density at scale: all Mew evidence is the 8-note sample notebook.
